context.purpose: Isolate every real root of a univariate polynomial with exact rational coefficients in disjoint rational intervals with multiplicities, certified independently of SymPy.
context.assumptions: Literal exact rational coefficients in descending powers; closed rational isolating intervals; isolated SymPy 1.14.0 (sympy.intervals(strict=True)) on POSIX.
context.constraints: Degree 1 to 12 (2 to 13 coefficients), numerator and denominator at most 40 digits, nonzero leading coefficient, maximum width within [1e-30, 1], at most 12 published intervals.
context.inspection: Inspect real-roots.csv and roots-verification.json (Sturm counts, square-free factor degrees, per-interval widths, point-root flags); roots-summary.json is native evidence only.
context.recovery: Correct located coefficient/width faults (expressions, decimals and zero leading coefficients are refused as data); a SYMPY_CERTIFICATION_FAILED fault means the native output was not accepted; configure exactly SymPy 1.14.0 for SYMPY_UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME.

workflow.scope: Independent verified runs in a scheduled workflow with resume reuse; the route accepts no incoming artifacts.

lifecycle.timeout: Single total deadline (default 60 s) over both native stages and host verification; native CPU 60 s, address space 4 GiB, 16 MiB per file.
lifecycle.cancellation: Owned process-group cancellation through the shared runner and a pre-publication check.
lifecycle.logs: Authored/plan/native configuration, worker and implementation fingerprints, consumed-input bindings, stage submissions, stdout/stderr, native fault records and readback record.
lifecycle.verification: Independent standard-library oracle: strict table grammar, Yun square-free decomposition rebuilt exactly, Sturm sequences per factor, closed-interval counts, ordering/disjointness/width and multiplicity-by-factor; the distinct real root count is computed from the coefficients, not taken from SymPy.

data.format: JSON array of exact rational literal strings
losses: Only exact rational literals of at most 40 digits; no decimals, expressions, symbols or radicals.
data.scope: Authored literal coefficients; nothing is parsed by SymPy from a string.

losses: Rational text, not a numeric column; consumers needing floating-point must convert and own that rounding.
Complex roots are counted in the verification record, never located.
data.scope: One row per distinct real root; empty table when the polynomial has no real root.

traits.decisions: none; native intervals, call identity and diagnostics only

data.scope: Native runtime identity and call record.

traits.method: Yun square-free decomposition and Sturm sequences in Fractions

data.scope: Sole final completeness, width, disjointness and multiplicity certificate.

inspection.scope: Inspect the root table, summary and verification record.
inspection.limits: No plot and no interactive native session.

authoring.reuse: Runs have no input files, so the reusable-input map is empty; resuming an unchanged workflow reuses verified runs and an edited workflow is refused.

native-inspection.scope: No interactive native session; inspect the verified table and the host verification record.

mpi.scope: One serial native process; no MPI.

live-editing.scope: No persistent native state or reverse editing.

conversion.scope: No format conversion; the route isolates the real roots of one polynomial.

native-save.scope: SymPy has no application document to save; publications are an inspectable CSV and JSON only (no pickle or srepr).

composition.scope: Not claimed: shared references, expressions and studies are not qualified for this route in this delivery.

workflow.scope: Independent verified runs in a scheduled workflow with resume reuse; no incoming artifacts are accepted.

reusable-inputs.scope: No input files: the reusable-input map is empty; resuming an unchanged workflow reuses verified runs and an edited workflow is refused with RESUME_MISMATCH.

source-authoring.scope: Editable coefficient and width declarations with undo through common authoring.

property-authoring.scope: Coefficient list entries and width are editable forms.

cases.scope: x^2 - 2: two irrational real roots (sqrt 2 is irrational, so no point interval can be certified); no complex roots. Counts only: interval endpoints are algorithm-dependent.
(x-1)^3 (x+2)^2 (x^2+1) expanded: exact roots -2 (multiplicity 2) and 1 (multiplicity 3) as point intervals, five real roots with multiplicity, two complex, square-free factors of degree 2, 1, 1.

completion.scope: Initial isolateRealRoots route: literal rational coefficient contract, width bounds, isolated SymPy 1.14.0 sympy.intervals(strict=True), independent Yun/Sturm certification, saved verification, workflow runs with resume reuse, discovery, guidance, Studio starters and upstream tracking.
